title: Dev DASH/ Pod inactivated by itself
symptom: The user reports that their DASH pod became unreachable and then suspended by itself, despite the phone being close to the pod. The pod did not reconnect automatically, and refreshing pod status did nothing until the user manually unsuspended it.
cause: The cause identified in the thread is that when updating basal rates via automation, the communication failed after the suspend step, leaving the pod suspended because setting the new basal rate did not succeed.
fix: The thread indicates that the issue was resolved by a pull request (https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/984), which likely fixed the underlying communication problem. No specific user action is given as a fix.
evidence_quote: I read the logs and it looks that the connection was lost when setting the new basal. That's why the pod ended up in a suspended state. The suspend worked, setting the new basal did not work.
